title: Exploration on the mechanism of crystal morphology transformation in mordenite
content:

DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00666J, Paper

The transformation of rod-like and flake-like mordenites is mainly related to the increasing ratio of SiO2/Al2O3, and HMI guides the T2 and T4 sites of the rod-like and flake-like mordenites specifically.
